reason_for_amendment.date_convention: The parent protocol specifies a calendar-date lower bound but does not specify a governing timezone for match_date.
reason_for_amendment.sampling_frame: The parent protocol specifies deterministic ordering within the candidate queue but does not completely define the source population and discovery procedure used to construct that queue.
reason_for_amendment.prior_discovery: The initial 25-record discovery corpus was assembled across two investigations without a prospectively frozen complete source snapshot. Some match outcomes, map information and technical-availability information were observed during that work.
reason_for_amendment.scientific_requirement: Preserve the previous discovery provenance and define the new prospective selection procedure before collecting the final Confirmation Candidate Queue.

new_prospective_sampling_window.reason: Use a new, explicitly declared prospective sampling window after the earlier provisional discovery process.

match_date_convention.date_definition: The UTC calendar date of the source-recorded scheduled match start time at the frozen metadata snapshot.
match_date_convention.timestamp_requirement: For every proposed candidate, record an unambiguous scheduled start timestamp, including its timezone or a Unix timestamp that can be converted to UTC.
match_date_convention.ambiguous_timestamp_policy: Do not guess a timezone or silently substitute a date from another display context. If the scheduled start time cannot be verified unambiguously, stop queue construction and document the issue before selecting candidates.
match_date_convention.post_freeze_schedule_change: Preserve the frozen queue identity, order and original source timestamp. Record subsequent schedule changes separately. Apply the parent protocol's technical eligibility and temporal boundary to the actual acquired match.

metadata_source.population: All upcoming Counter-Strike match entries shown by the unfiltered HLTV matches listing in one complete, documented source snapshot.
metadata_source.source_access_failure: If HLTV cannot be accessed or a complete listing snapshot cannot be established, stop. Do not replace the source with an unrecorded alternative.

candidate_selection.candidate_pool: Distinct HLTV match IDs in the complete source snapshot whose scheduled start time is at or after 2026-09-21T00:00:00Z and strictly later than the documented source-capture time.
candidate_selection.historical_provisional_match_id_policy: Exclude the 25 match IDs in the already committed provisional discovery corpus from the new prospective sampling frame. This is a predeclared separation rule, not a technical-eligibility judgment.
candidate_selection.selection_rule: Select exactly the first 25 distinct match IDs from the complete prospective candidate pool in pool_order.
candidate_selection.candidate_rank: Assign ranks 1 through 25 only after applying final_queue_order to the selected 25 matches.
candidate_selection.insufficient_pool_rule: If fewer than 25 matches satisfy the frozen sampling rules in the complete source snapshot, stop. Do not silently extend the capture window, switch sources, or hand-pick additional matches. Any revised sampling method requires a new versioned amendment committed before further collection.

metadata_fields.unknown_participant_policy: Preserve a nonempty source-listed placeholder when a participant is not determined at snapshot time. Do not replace the match or select another candidate because its participants are unknown.
metadata_fields.metadata_correction_policy: Preserve the original source snapshot. Record any correction with a reason and source evidence before final queue freeze. Do not correct or replace entries based on observed maps, demo availability, target distribution or model performance.

required: The amendment must be committed before new prospective metadata collection.
The complete HLTV source snapshot and its capture timestamp must be preserved.
Every selected match must have an auditable scheduled_start_utc and source_match_id.
The prospective candidate pool and deterministic first-25 selection must be reproducible from the frozen source snapshot.
The existing provisional 25-record discovery corpus must remain unchanged and must not enter the new prospective queue.
The final 25-row queue must follow the parent protocol's required schema and ordering.
The queue and source evidence must be committed before any new raw demo download.
Technical eligibility must be evaluated only after final queue freeze.

unchanged_parent_requirements.selection_of_eligible_matches: First 20 technically eligible candidates in frozen candidate_rank order.
unchanged_parent_requirements.allowed_technical_exclusions: As specified in the original frozen acquisition protocol.
unchanged_parent_requirements.shortfall_policy: As specified in the original frozen acquisition protocol.

revision_policy: Do not overwrite this amendment after commit. A change to the prospective sampling frame, date convention or selection rule requires a new, explicitly versioned and committed amendment before the affected collection activity.
